spec_match.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-25: container-type is now the valid `inline-size` (css-contain-3 grammar has no `style` container-type value; every element is a style container automatically), the code sample teaches the corrected declaration, and the engine verdict line proved all three rules firing per spec on Chromium 153 (size at >320px content-box, style() on --featured: true, comma OR on either).

interactive.rationale: Width slider, featured toggle, drag-resizable container (now tracked by ResizeObserver so dragging feeds the same state path), a live truth-table matrix, and an engine-verdict readout — every control was driven headless and changed the rendered card and readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise (resizable card, custom-property flag, Rule C comma OR, live truth table) matches the page.

edge_cases.rationale: The engine-verdict line is read back from computed styles, so a parser that drops any rule shows an honest 'does not fire'; an explicit requires-Chrome-150 support note appears whenever the observed state disagrees with the expected matrix (hidden on this supporting build, verified).

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6196591858941952 and the CSS Conditional 5 spec in see-also.

conformance.rationale: The shared feature suite runs 4 pass / 1 fail on Chromium 153; the four real parse/CSSOM contracts pass. The one failing assertion (comma-list-parses-via-supports) is flagged for a human on the breakpoint-matrix critique — CSS.supports cannot express an @container comma list, so it fails even on supporting builds.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session, so per auto-research.md §0 this is NOT MCP browser verification — but unlike earlier load-only reviews, every control was driven via headless Chromium 153 (Playwright/CDP over the real Chrome binary): slider sweeps 200→600px, featured toggle both ways, matrix highlight, engine verdicts, support-note visibility; zero console errors, zero failed requests; full-page screenshots read at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3, re-run fresh after the final edit (77/77 checks).

telemetry_health.rationale: The page now asserts `mixed-cq-engine-matches-expected` (observed computed styles vs expected clause arithmetic) on every state change, so a parser regression or false-success would surface in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: The code sample's raw `green` is now var(--accent-emerald) matching the real rule; all colours are CSS variables; toggle active states set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Off/On toggles carry aria-pressed (verified flipping), the engine verdict is a polite live region announcing rule state in text, controls are native button/range with labels, and the badge changes are mirrored by the live region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: no horizontal page overflow (control rows wrap; the reference table and the resizable card sit in their own overflow-x scrollers), and the wide >320px state is genuinely reachable on mobile inside the card's scroller — all matrix states were driven on both classes.

summary: Repaired 2026-10-25 (weekly hardening): removed the invalid `container-type: inline-size style` that killed the size branch everywhere and taught broken grammar; the truth-table/matrix state is now read back from the engine (getComputedStyle on the card body and badges) with the slider/drag arithmetic shown only as the expected state, a requires-Chrome-150 note when they disagree, and a telemetry assert pinning agreement. Also: ResizeObserver tracks drag-resize, aria-pressed + live region added, mobile overflow fixed with wrapping controls and scrollers. Verified on headless Chromium 153 (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all three rules observed firing per spec on desktop and mobile, 77/77 scripted checks, clean console/network, fresh reload after the final edit.
